title: Canonical identity-open compactification comparisons
statement: Let $A$ be a finite commutative ring and $i:Z\hookrightarrow P$ a closed immersion [def-weil-closed-immersion]. Let $c=(\mathrm{id}_Z,i)$ be its identity-open compactification [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. In the ordinary constant-$A$ derived module categories on the small etale and pro-etale sites [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-modules], define canonical natural isomorphisms $e_i:R i_!^{c,\mathrm{et}}\xrightarrow{\sim}R i_{\mathrm{et},*}$ and $q_i:R i_!^{c,\mathrm{pro}}\xrightarrow{\sim}R i_{\mathrm{pro},*}$ [def-amb-etale-compact-support], [def-weil-compact-support-candidate], [def-weil-pbc-direct-image], [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] as follows. Identify identity inverse image with the identity functor; use its specified extension-by-zero adjunction to identify identity extension by zero with the identity, by adjunction uniqueness; descend this natural isomorphism termwise to derived categories, apply the canonical derived identity comparison, whisker on the right by the derived direct image of $i$, and finish with the left unitor. These are the specified constructions, not arbitrary isomorphisms; they impose no boundedness restriction.
